title: Wet Silk
reference_source: Максимальный гламурный регистр в рамках одетого кадра
mood_ru: Пар, вода, чёрный камень. Тяжёлый мокрый шёлк и прямой взгляд.
allure: wet-look glamour, soaked opaque silk clinging to every curve, water running over her skin, parted lips, heavy-lidded direct gaze

wardrobe.notes_ru: Короткая чёрная шёлковая комбинация, насквозь мокрая, но плотная и непрозрачная.
wardrobe.prompt: short black silk slip dress soaked through and clinging to her body, opaque heavy silk, thin straps slipping off the shoulders, wet hair slicked back, water beading on her skin, silver star pendant, bare feet

location.notes_ru: Душевая за стеклом, чёрный мрамор, пар, латунь. Вода льётся во всех кадрах.
location.prompt: large walk-in rain shower behind fogged glass, black marble walls and floor, brass fixtures, thick steam, water running down the glass, wet reflections, single warm overhead light

shots.pose: standing directly under the rain shower head with water pouring over her, both hands sliding the soaked hair back from her face, elbows raised, back arched, chin lowered and eyes straight into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, frontal, thigh-up framing
shots.light: warm overhead spot burning through the falling water, cool rim off the wet glass behind her

shots.pose: pressed against the fogged glass from inside the shower, one palm and her cheek flat on the glass, back deeply arched, head turned sideways to hold the lens through the condensation
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, three-quarter front angle, waist-up framing
shots.light: warm light from behind her inside the shower, cool spill through the fogged glass

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the wet black marble bench, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: single warm overhead spot cutting through the steam, cool blue light bouncing off the wet glass along her shoulder

shots.pose: standing close to the fogged shower glass, one hand resting on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, holding her own gaze while the camera catches her and the reflection at once
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: single warm overhead spot cutting through the steam, cool blue light bouncing off the wet glass along her shoulder

shots.pose: standing at the glass wall of the shower with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, back to the camera, long line of the spine on show, looking away into the light
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view, full body vertical framing
shots.light: single warm overhead spot cutting through the steam, cool blue light bouncing off the wet glass along her shoulder

shots.pose: reclining back on the wet black marble bench propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: single warm overhead spot cutting through the steam, cool blue light bouncing off the wet glass along her shoulder

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of water running down her collarbones and the wet silk strap, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: single warm overhead spot cutting through the steam, cool blue light bouncing off the wet glass along her shoulder

shots.pose: lying on her back on the wet black marble bench, one arm thrown above her head, the other hand resting on her waist, hair fanned out, knees softly bent, eyes lifted to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, directly overhead top-down angle, full body framing
shots.light: single warm overhead spot cutting through the steam, cool blue light bouncing off the wet glass along her shoulder

shots.pose: standing tall directly under the rain shower head, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight shifted onto one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: single warm overhead spot cutting through the steam, cool blue light bouncing off the wet glass along her shoulder

shots.pose: seen small across the space behind the fogged glass of the shower, caught mid-movement and not looking at the camera, the room itself carrying the mood
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: single warm overhead spot cutting through the steam, cool blue light bouncing off the wet glass along her shoulder

film: shot on Cinestill 800T, halation around the highlights, grain in the steam
